source: one fresh official HTML notice selected separately, exact source binding pending; no convenient replacement after outcomes
comparison: automated direct source+candidate versus automated source-first A/C/B, same model/settings/full source/candidate; C automation replaces round11 human scope intervention
candidate_authorship: Separate source-only AI child authors full candidate offline, before all verifier outputs. This candidate is experimental input, not gold or a source-completeness oracle. Share identical candidate with D/B. Log source exposure and agent labor. Candidate author never supplies scope annotations or assessment to models.
independent_assessment: Separate AI child assesses complete source only before outputs, freezes source obligations, background and unresolved facts. No candidate or A/C/D/B output. Prior exposure disclosed. This is independent AI assessment, not blind human gold. Keep its files and later crosswalk out of all stage inputs.
postrun_review: Independent AI reviewer crosswalks D source units and A units to same frozen independent source assessment after outputs. Review C scope decisions and D scope decisions against full source, and B/D mappings against exact operative values. Source assessment can itself be wrong or incomplete; adjudicate disagreements transparently and preserve unknowns, never retroactively repair model outputs.
reverse_audit: Separately audit every original candidate operative field/assertion after outputs, including compound values, identity associations and unsupported additions. Bind source, original record and exact operative projection hashes. Source-to-record coverage does not certify fidelity.
crosswalk: Many-to-many adjudicated assertion crosswalk; generated unit count is not denominator. For both arms independently identify candidate source omissions correctly/incorrectly flagged and source obligations absent from their discovery. D source discovery is its returned source_unit list; source-first discovery is A. C cannot add missing A units.
metrics: attempt/validity/stop/size status for each planned stage and both arms
independently assessed required/context claims discovered and not discovered per arm, with unknowns
scope agreement/error/unknown against reviewed source functions, with C and D separately
known candidate losses correctly flagged and false loss alarms using perarm assertion crosswalk
roles, modality, conditions, relationships and background separately
raw known losses plus effective unknown closure
unsupported record additions and whole-record fidelity in separate reverse audit
reported provider cost, frozen-rate estimate and conservative debit separately
offline source/candidate/assessment/review agent labor and exposure separate from provider debit
interpretation: one feasibility diagnostic, no accuracy/generalization or ordering-only causality claim
four calls versus one is a systems comparison; differing stage count/prompts/representation confound order
AI source assessment is fallible, not human gold
contract fixtures do not measure model discovery/classification/matching
no live compatibility or production readiness claim

budget.admission: For each attempted call retain reservation even on uncertain failure; debit max(reserve,reported cost,frozen-rate estimate). Recalculate actual remaining allowance before every dependent call. Any inability to fit reservation stops that call; no fifth call.

protocol_design_exposure: Primary read fresh source before requesting this generic actor/proceeding/function clarification. Protocol author did not read fresh source during generic freeze. No clean blind design claim; source-selection/design exposure disclosed separately from pre-output independent AI assessment.
